qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Professional engineering services and infrastructure consulting operate in highly fragmented, competitive bidding markets with limited pricing power over wage inflation. Multi-cycle ROIC has historically ranged from 1% to 8%, falling far short of the 12% Gate 3b hurdle despite proprietary CANDU nuclear reactor servicing.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (REJECT). Professional engineering consulting and infrastructure services operate in competitive bidding environments with sub-hurdle multi-cycle ROIC (<8% vs 12% requirement) and limited pricing power over consultant wage inflation.
qualitative.evidence: AtkinsRealis (formerly SNC-Lavalin) has historical multi-cycle ROIC well below 12% (1-8% range) due to legacy lump-sum turnkey project write-downs and competitive bidding on engineering consulting contracts. Even with the pivot to higher-margin nuclear and consulting services, capital returns fail the Munger moat standard.
